info.name: User Management
info.description:
## Users

### Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication
User endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{user_access_token}}`. Admin endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}`. Auth (OTP) endpoints are public.

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `user_access_token` | User JWT (auto-set on OTP verify) |
| `user_refresh_token` | User refresh token (auto-set on OTP verify) |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on login) |

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public OTP-based authentication endpoints for users.

request.description:
### Auth
None — public.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone number, normalized to international form (e.g. `+963944123456`). |

### Notes
Issuing an OTP for an unknown phone is fine — the user row is auto-provisioned on first successful verify. Enforces a per-phone resend cooldown and a rolling issue-rate cap. If WhatsApp dispatch fails, the response still succeeds with a `warning` field set.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 400 | Resend cooldown not elapsed |
| 401 | Phone locked due to too many failed attempts |
| 422 | Validation failed (bad phone format) |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

### Auth
None — public.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone number, same one the OTP was issued for. |
| code | string | YES | 4–8 digit OTP code received via WhatsApp. |

### Notes
On success, creates or fetches the matching user row, issues an access token and an opaque refresh token. Response includes `requiresProfileCompletion` so the client knows whether to route into onboarding. The test script auto-saves both tokens into environment variables keyed by role.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | No active code, invalid code, expired, too many attempts, or phone locked |
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

item.name: Profile
item.description: User self-profile endpoints. All routes require a user access token.

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{user_access_token}}` — required (User role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| firstName | string | YES | 1–100 chars, name characters only. |
| lastName | string | YES | 1–100 chars, name characters only. |
| gender | enum | YES | `male` or `female`. |
| birthDate | ISO-8601 date | YES | Must be in the past. |
| cityId | number | YES | Existing city ID. |
| address | string | Optional | Free-text, up to 512 chars. |

### Notes
Flips `isProfileCompleted` to true. Calling it again after completion returns 400.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 400 | Profile already completed |
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{user_access_token}}` — required (User role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| firstName | string | Optional | 1–100 chars. |
| lastName | string | Optional | 1–100 chars. |
| gender | enum \| null | Optional | `male` or `female`. |
| birthDate | ISO-8601 date \| null | Optional | Must be in the past. |
| cityId | number \| null | Optional | Existing city ID, or `null` to clear. |
| address | string \| null | Optional | Up to 512 chars. |

### Notes
Undefined fields are skipped (no change). Nullable fields accept `null` to clear them.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |
| 422 | Validation failed |

formdata.description: Profile photo file. Allowed mime types and size limits enforced by the storage layer (jpeg/png/webp; ~5MB).

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{user_access_token}}` — required (User role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| photo | file | YES | Single file upload (multipart/form-data). Replaces any existing photo. |

### Notes
Replaces the previous photo if one exists. Subject to the upload throttle.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 413 | File too large |
| 415 | Unsupported media type |
| 429 | Upload throttle exceeded |

### Auth
Bearer `{{user_access_token}}` — required (User role).

### Input
None — reads the principal from the access token.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone, unique across users. |
| firstName | string | YES | 1–100 chars. |
| lastName | string | YES | 1–100 chars. |
| gender | enum | YES | `male` or `female`. |
| birthDate | ISO-8601 date | YES | Must be in the past. |
| cityId | number | YES | Existing city ID. |
| address | string | Optional | Up to 512 chars. |

### Notes
Bypasses the OTP flow used by user self-onboarding. Created with `isProfileCompleted = true`.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |
| 409 | Phone already registered |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| page | number | Optional | Page number (default 1). |
| limit | number | Optional | Items per page (default 10). |
| search | string | Optional | Free-text match against `firstName` / `lastName` / `phone`. |
| isProfileCompleted | boolean | Optional | Filter by onboarding completion. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| userId | path param | YES | User ID. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | User not found |
